initial_segment: travel agencies and small tourism operators
objective: Find a specific, source-backed business problem before proposing or building a solution.

offer_hypothesis.name: Mobile-first digital service pack
scope: clear contact or WhatsApp action using a business-provided public contact route
service descriptions in up to two agreed languages
exclusions: guaranteed traffic, leads, sales or revenue
use of unlicensed images, logos or copy
offer_hypothesis.pricing_rule: Quote only after discovery and scope confirmation; agree in writing before work starts.

primary_endpoint: At least one real payment from an unrelated customer for the defined pilot within seven calendar days after the first valid outreach.

states.HOLD_RESEARCH: Business status, current contact, or specific issue not sufficiently verified.
states.READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW: Public contact route verified, at least one specific observed issue has a source and date, and the proposed fix is in scope.
states.CONTACTED: A human-reviewed individual message was actually sent; record date and channel.
states.PAID_PILOT: Payment evidence recorded for the agreed scope.
states.NOT_A_FIT: Issue outside scope, no reachable business route, or prospect explicitly declines.

anti_bias: Do not claim a company has a problem without evidence.
Do not invent market prices, conversion rates, willingness-to-pay or revenue.
Record silence and rejection, not only positive responses.
Do not start the seven-day window before the first valid outreach.
Keep separate from BHD, miRNA-21 and Quran/IQCL projects.
